messages:
alexa: heads-up — bringing up zephyrus14b-int4 on canary and hitting intermittent OOMs. setup: batch_size=4, max_new_tokens=1024, quant=per-channel int4. repros higher under sustained traffic.
alexa: quick repro command we used: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"zephyrus14b-int4","input":"<long prompt>","max_new_tokens":1024,"batch_size":4}'`
raj: can you paste the raw OOM snippet?
alexa: log snippet below (trimmed):
```
E tensorflow/allocator: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[host: i-0a12] free fragments after 90s: total_free=1.1GiB, largest=120MiB
KV cache growth: +6% per 1000 tokens under streaming
```
morgan: my first guess is memory fragmentation + large max_new_tokens. int4 per-channel helps accuracy but increases temporary working set during kernel tiling. couple suggestions: reduce default max_new_tokens for this model to 512 on canary, enable soft_reserve (0.06-0.1), and lower prefetch threads. also try kv_trim_on_idle and faster compaction.
morgan: config snippet to try:
```yaml
model: zephyrus14b-int4
canary: true
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 512
  batch_size: 4
  soft_reserve: 0.08
  prefetch: false
  kv_trim_on_idle: true
  slot_compactor_interval_s: 60
  eviction_policy: lru_age
```
raj: another knob — switch final-layer quant to per-tensor for memory saving (small quality hit) and run the reg eval. we should also snapshot kernel memory usage timeline to see if fragments spike after long-lived allocations.
serena: plan proposal:
- rollout A: 5% traffic with soft_reserve + kv_trim (monitor OOM and latency)
- rollout B: 10% with reduced max_new_tokens (512)
- rollout C: 5% try per-tensor final-layer quant to measure quality drop
- run eval set `zephyrus-regress-2026-03` (500 prompts) for all 3 variants
serena: metrics to watch: OOM count, p95 latency, tokens/sec, quality regression (exact-match / nist BLEU-ish), and hallucination rate.
alexa: quick bench on dev rig before changes: p50=95ms, p95=430ms, tokens/s~190. memory baseline shows 22GiB resident, free fragments rise after 2k requests.
morgan: also add a soft fallback policy: if OOMs > 1 in 10 minutes, fallback to a slightly smaller model (zephyrus13b-int4) or reduce max_new_tokens on the fly.
infra-bot: scheduled canary deploys at 2026-03-23T03:00Z for rollout A/B/C. healthchecks enabled.
alexa: I'll kick off the three variants and paste the first-night logs here. tagging @morgan @raj @serena for visibility. thanks! :thumbsup:
